user.title: SkyRC Charger
user.description: Pick a charger in range, or type its Bluetooth address. The charger must be reachable by a Bluetooth adapter or an active Bluetooth proxy.

data_description.address: The charger shows up as #Charger followed by four characters.
data_description.passcode: The four digits the charger asks for: the one shown on its screen on the MC5000 (1234 from the factory), 5793 on the older chargers. Leave empty for the factory one.

confirm.title: Set up {name}
confirm.description: Home Assistant found a SkyRC charger. Enter its passcode to connect.

data_description.passcode: The four digits the charger asks for: the one shown on its screen on the MC5000 (1234 from the factory), 5793 on the older chargers. Leave empty for the factory one.

reauth_confirm.title: Passcode refused
reauth_confirm.description: {name} refused the passcode. Enter the one shown on the charger's screen.

data_description.passcode: The four digits the charger shows on its screen. 1234 from the factory.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the charger. It must be on and reachable by a Bluetooth adapter or an active Bluetooth proxy.
error.unsupported_model: This charger is not a model the integration supports yet.

init.title: SkyRC charger
init.description: The charger only obeys a client that sent its passcode first.

start_slot.name: Start slot
start_slot.description: Write a program to a slot, which starts it. A slot that already runs a program is refused: stop it first.

slot.description: Slot number, 1 to 4 (1 to 8 on the type 228).

chemistry.name: Chemistry
chemistry.description: What is in the slot. Defaults to the slot's Expected Chemistry select when that is not "any".

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Lithium cells take charge, storage, discharge or cycle; nickel cells charge, refresh, break_in, discharge or cycle; NiZn and RAM cells charge, discharge or cycle.

current_ma.name: Current
current_ma.description: Charge current. Defaults to what the SkyRC app proposes for the chemistry.

capacity_mah.name: Capacity
